title: Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications
abstract: arXiv:2611.18958v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model (MLM)-aided token reconstruction. In the proposed framework, the receiver detects unreliable token positions from channel reliability and constructs a vocabulary-level channel-posterior. In particular, within the receiver, Posterior-Weighted Input Embedding (PWE) injects this posterior into the MLM input, while Adaptive Output Logit Fusion (AOF) reuses it at the output with a channel-adaptive weight. Consequently, multiple unreliable tokens can be reconstructed in a single bidirectional MLM inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional MLM training. translated_title: 面向掩码语言模型（MLM）辅助令牌通信的双阶段信道后验融合框架
translated_abstract: 基于传统数字调制的令牌传输容易受到信道损伤的影响，导致比特错误，使接收到的令牌在语义上下文中出现不一致。本文提出了一种接收端双阶段信道后验融合框架，用于掩码语言模型（MLM）辅助的令牌重建。在所提出的框架中，接收端根据信道可靠性检测不可靠的令牌位置，并构建词表级别的信道后验分布。具体而言，在接收端内部，后验加权输入嵌入（PWE）将该后验注入MLM的输入端，而自适应输出Logit融合（AOF）则在输出端以信道自适应权重复用该后验。因此，仅需一次双向MLM推理即可重建多个不可靠令牌，无需重传、发送端编码或额外的MLM训练。在噪声信道上的实验表明，余弦相似度最高可提升67.2%（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种接收端双阶段信道后验融合框架，通过PWE将词表级信道后验注入MLM输入、AOF在输出端自适应融合，仅需一次双向推理即可重建多个不可靠令牌，无需重传、发送端编码或额外训练，余弦相似度最高提升67.2%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for MLM-aided token reconstruction, where PWE injects vocabulary-level channel posteriors into the MLM input and AOF adaptively fuses them at the output, enabling reconstruction of multiple unreliable tokens in a single bidirectional inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional training, achieving up to 67.2% improvement in cosine similarity.
